content.short: Aqua Protocol is a decentralized stablecoin protocol on TON that allows users to mint AquaUSD against collateral.
content.description: Aqua Protocol is a leading decentralized stablecoin and lending protocol built on the TON blockchain. It allows users to mint AquaUSD, a decentralized stablecoin, by providing over-collateralized assets such as staked TON or other Jettons. By offering a stable medium of exchange and a way to unlock liquidity from holdings without selling them, Aqua Protocol provides essential financial utility to the TON ecosystem. Its focus on security and capital efficiency makes it a core component of the network's growing decentralized finance landscape.
